ARIRANG GARDEN — 90-SECOND GAME MUSIC LOOP

Traditional melody: Arirang, Korean folk song.
New arrangement, accompaniment, synthesized plucked-string lead, and mix created
for this project. No pre-existing recording of an Arirang performance was used.

Modifications: onset trimming, pitch resampling, amplitude/envelope editing,
new note sequencing, stereo mixing, synthetic reverberation, circular tail
wrapping, loop-marker insertion and audio encoding.
